info.description:
This course equips students with 
a brief summary of the history of American Literature by looking through the confluences among influential literary trends in American literature
 and generalization of American literature history from the very beginning of the USA establishment to the first half of the 20
th
 century.
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Acquire brief summary of the history of American literature by looking through the confluences among influential literary trends in American literature;
Apply figures of speech, essay-writing skills and approaches to absorbing literature in order to make comparisons and practice making criticisms on target literary works;
Beware of the significance of the course in order to self-improve literary knowledge, self-train operational skills for future careers;
Appreciate prominent literary works in American literature in attempt to spark discussions on human values of the works, thus flourishing such values of students themselves.
